scripts.map:setup: py -3.12 -m venv precompute/.venv && precompute\.venv\Scripts\python -m pip install -r precompute/requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm ci --prefix server --omit=dev && npm ci --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && oxlint --deny-warnings server/src server/test shared e2e playwright.config.js
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build --prefix client && playwright test
